name: Regulus Corneas
japaneseName: レグルス・コルニアス
description: Regulus Corneas was the Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult representing Greed and the leader of its radical faction. Arrogant, narcissistic, and obsessively sensitive about his perceived 'rights', he possessed near-invincibility through the Authority of Greed. Debuting at the end of Arc 3 by annihilating Crusch's convoy alongside Lye Batenkaitos, he served as one of the primary antagonists during the siege of Priestella in Arc 5.
